bias_targets.target: Demographic bias (Intersection of Age, Gender, Ethnicity, Relationship Status, Country of Origin)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating clustering outcomes using a 'Fair K-Means' statistical technique on census data to ensure the clusters proportionally respect demographic characteristics across multiple multi-valued sensitive attributes.
Analyzing the distribution of content types in Instagram feeds using a browser plug-in installed by volunteers to measure algorithmic skew toward images showing skin/nudity.

Comparing failure rates and performance metrics of speech recognition systems and evaluating algorithmic decision-making tools (e.g., law enforcement background checks and facial recognition) for disparities affecting Black individuals and minority communities.
Assessing the failure rates of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems when interacting with non-mainstream accents and people who speak English as a second language.

Systematic analysis and hypothesis testing of failure modes in computer vision, speech systems, and text processing algorithms when exposed to atypical inputs from people with physical, cognitive, or speech disabilities (e.g., atypical speech patterns, facial features, or mobility differences).
